STEP 1 - Scene: A salad-style plate with arugula (rocket) on one side and a cooked grain/lentil-like mix (looks like brown lentils or farro with bits of nut or cheese) on the other. Photographed from above, roughly top-down, so the plate reads close to its true shape.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square-ish plate, about 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: (1) Arugula/rocket leaves, with a few small crumbles of white cheese. (2) Cooked brown lentils or grain mixed with small pieces, likely with a bit of dressing or sheen.

STEP 4 - Area: Arugula ~30% of plate (about 160 cm^2). Lentil/grain mix ~22% (about 115 cm^2). Total food coverage ~52%.

STEP 5 - Volume: Arugula pile ~160 cm^2 x 3 cm ≈ 480 ml (outer envelope). Lentil mix ~115 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 170 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Arugula 480 ml x 0.15 ≈ 72 g. Cooked lentils 170 ml x 0.85 ≈ 145 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Arugula ~25 kcal/100 g → 72 g ≈ 18 kcal. Cooked lentils ~116 kcal/100 g → 145 g ≈ 168 kcal. Cheese crumbles (a few pieces, ~3 g at ~380 kcal/100 g) ≈ 11 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A half-covered 26 cm plate with a leafy salad and a modest grain/legume portion totaling about 220 g and roughly 200 kcal is plausible for what is visible.

Estimated total: about 220 g, about 197 kcal.
